accepted.text: A Kähler group is the fundamental group of a compact connected Kähler manifold. For r≥1 and closed connected orientable surfaces S_gᵢ of genus gᵢ≥2, characterize subgroups H≤π₁(S_g₁)×⋯×π₁(S_gᵣ) which are Kähler groups.

accepted.title: Relative homotopy for maps with fibre-isolated critical points
accepted.text: Let X be a compact connected complex manifold, Y a positive-dimensional complex torus or a closed Riemann surface of positive genus, and h:X→Y a surjective holomorphic map with connected generic smooth fibre H. Suppose Crit(h)∩h⁻¹(y) is discrete for every y∈Y. Pull h back along the universal cover Ỹ→Y to obtain X̂→Ỹ and identify H with a generic fibre in X̂. Must πᵢ(X̂,H)=0 for every i≤dim_ℂH? If dim_ℂH≥2, must h_*:π₁X→π₁Y be surjective with kernel isomorphic to π₁H?
accepted.subject: Topology & Kähler Groups
